appDesc.message: Analyze how a website authenticates you after sign-in, then copy the login data or a ready-to-use auth config with instructions.

overlayRecordingText.message: Just sign in normally. When you are done, click the button below to see how this site recognizes logins.

overlayUnknownText.message: Looks like the sign-in did not complete. Click “Keep recording”, then analyze again when you are done.

overlayEmptyCred.message: No login data was read. Make sure you are signed in, or click “Analyze again”.

overlayMulti.message: Both cookies and a token are needed — use “Copy usage notes”.

overlayCopyFailed.message: Copy failed — open the extension popup to copy manually

overlayPermissionRevoked.message: Access to this site was revoked — enable it again in the extension.
